full_prompt_en: A dramatic digital landscape painting depicts a vast hurricane from an elevated, almost orbital viewpoint. A small dark eye sits a little left of center, surrounded by tightly wound ribbons of ivory cloud that brighten into a concentrated whirl. The spiral opens outward in sweeping curved bands, rising toward the upper edge and dragging darker blue-gray vapor around the right side. Below the brilliant inner wall, storm clouds break into rough, foaming textures over a deep teal expanse. The lower corners carry the heaviest shadow, where hints of muted brown and green make the illuminated center feel even more powerful. Individual cloud ridges catch cool white light, while neighboring troughs fall into navy and charcoal. The picture is built through tactile, directional strokes and finely flecked highlights rather than smooth meteorological realism; the marks themselves trace the motion of the rotating mass. Some outer wisps dissolve softly into the blue atmosphere, while sharper streaks along the inner spiral provide a strong visual pull toward the eye. The composition has no conventional horizon, allowing scale to come from the changing size and density of the cloud formations. Cool, diffuse light seems to filter from the upper left across the lifted cloud tops. The whole frame holds an immense circular force in a textured balance of brightness, depth, and sweeping motion.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅富于戏剧性的数字风景绘画，以近乎轨道俯瞰的视角呈现一场巨大的飓风。稍偏左的画面中央有一处小小的深色风眼，周围紧密盘绕的象牙白云带逐渐明亮，形成集中的漩涡。螺旋向外展开为大幅弯曲的云带，向上边缘升起，并将更暗的蓝灰色水汽卷过右侧。明亮的内壁下方，暴风云层在深青色区域上破碎成粗粝、似浪花翻涌的肌理。下方两角积聚最重的阴影，其中隐约的暗棕和绿色让明亮的中心更显有力。每道云脊捕捉冷白色光线，邻近的凹谷则落入海军蓝和炭黑色。画面通过有触感、带明确方向的笔触和细碎的高光建立形体，而非平滑的气象写实；笔迹本身就描出旋转云团的运动。外缘的一些云丝柔软地融进蓝色大气，内侧螺旋上较锐利的条纹则将目光强烈拉向风眼。构图没有常见的地平线，尺度感来自云团尺寸与密度的变化。冷而漫射的光仿佛从左上方滤过隆起的云顶。整幅画以明度、深度和大幅回旋的动态，在粗粝的肌理中凝聚一股巨大的环形力量。
style_prompt_en: The digital landscape image is composed of sweeping curved strokes, layered blue-gray and deep teal masses, and concentrated ivory highlights. A small dark recess anchors an otherwise expanding circulation of pale ridges and shadowed troughs. Tactile, directional marks follow the turning structure, with flecked bright edges alternating against broad, soft vapor. The highest values gather in one compact area before thinning into cooler, darker zones toward the borders. Some contours are crisp and energetic; others fade into atmospheric blue, so the surface shifts between physical texture and immaterial haze. A muted brown-green undertone at the lowest edge deepens the palette without disturbing its cool dominance. The absence of a fixed horizon lets scale emerge from the rhythm of marks and the widening arcs. The whole frame feels immense, turbulent, and luminous, its sense of motion carried by painterly structure rather than literal detail.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅数字风景图像由大幅弯曲的笔触、层叠的蓝灰与深青色块，以及集中的象牙白高光构成。一处小小的暗部凹点锚定不断向外扩展的循环形态，周围是浅色隆脊与阴影沟谷。带有触感和方向性的痕迹顺着回旋结构运行，细碎的明亮边缘与宽阔柔软的水汽交替。最高明度聚在一处紧凑区域，随后向边缘逐渐稀薄，转入更冷、更暗的色域。有些轮廓清晰而充满能量，另一些则隐入大气感蓝色，使画面表面在可触的肌理与无形的薄雾之间变化。最下缘少量暗棕绿色底调加深色盘，却没有打破冷色主导。没有固定地平线，尺度感由笔迹的节奏和不断扩大的弧线生成。整幅画显得浩大、翻涌而明亮，运动感主要由绘画结构而非逐物细节承载。
theme_en: A vast hurricane seen from above
name: Hurricane
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
